params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: question  Priority: P2
Summary: The homepage collage includes a recognisable character from a well-known franchise (Pikachu). Keep it or replace that one fragment; the rest of the collage stays.

Listed in the brief as a decision for the client, not for this pass. Worth deciding soon: a recognisable trademarked character on a commercial site is a rights question, and replacing one fragment is small once decided.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Homepage collage contains a recognisable licensed character
